item.description:
New

  • Each Claude Code session card shows what the session has cost so far at API prices, and it updates as the session works.
  • Visor warns when an agent keeps failing or repeating the same call: one peek in the closed notch and a Stuck? card with Ignore and Open. It clears by itself once the agent recovers, you send a new prompt, or the agent stops.
  • When a Claude limit is about to run out, a card in the Agents tab names the agents that still have room and copies a handoff note (project, task, files touched, last test run) for one of them. The note is kept out of clipboard history, and the card goes by itself after the reset.
  • A consistent look across every tab: the same buttons, cards, badges, headers, text sizes and corners everywhere, from one design system.
  • Text on coloured buttons and badges is always easy to read: white on blue, red and green, black on the light colours.
  • Plugins can build with Visor's own pieces: banner cards, badges, section headers, primary and secondary buttons, colours by name and text sizes by step, so a plugin looks like Visor's own tabs. A plugin colour too dark for the notch is lightened.
  • A new design system page shows every colour, size and shared piece, live, with the code for apps and plugins.

Fixes

  • The context ring now updates after each prompt and after a compact, and no longer shows an old value after Visor restarts.
  • A plugin with a malformed colour can no longer crash Visor.
  • The Stuck and handoff cards have even padding on all sides, and an agent with no limit reading says why instead of showing an empty bar.

New

  • Visor says hello every time it starts: the intro plays, then a short "Hi, I'm Visor" with the version, which closes by itself after 3 seconds or on a click. The first launch keeps the full welcome.

Fixes

  • An approval card no longer disappears when a subagent, or another call of the same tool, finishes while it waits. It stays until its own request is answered.
  • A new log, ~/Library/Logs/Visor/approvals.log, records when each approval came and how it ended (agent, project folder, tool), never the command, so a missing card can be traced.

Fixes

  • A release card now clears by itself once the tool is updated, from its Update button or your own terminal: it shows "Updated" for a moment, then goes. Cards for tools updated while Visor was closed clear at launch.
  • Tools installed from a Homebrew tap other than Homebrew core no longer get an update card they can't use.
